backingType.note: Liquid staking protocol: mETH represents staked ETH plus accrued rewards.

attestationAgeDays.note: Backing is verifiable on-chain by construction; exchange-rate oracle updates every ~8 hours.

collateralRatio.note: 1:1 staked-ETH backing with rewards reflected in the exchange rate.

noticeDays.note: Average ~3.75 days, documented maximum ~7.5 days (post liquidity-buffer); minimum claim delay ~12h.

singlePointsOfFailure.note: Protocol oracle/operator set as the principal off-chain dependency.

bridgeDependency.note: Staking occurs on Ethereum L1; the Mantle-network representation depends on the canonical bridge.

attestationCadenceDays.note: State continuously on-chain; oracle refresh ~8h. Scored as daily-equivalent.

docsCompleteness.note: Checklist: full protocol docs, risk-management section (slashing, griefing), unstake lifecycle documented.
